fsm_states_link_state_management.name: RESET
fsm_states_link_state_management.description: Initial state after power-up / reset assertion. PHY and Adapter held; sideband prepared for bring-up.

fsm_states_link_state_management.name: SBINIT
fsm_states_link_state_management.description: Sideband initialization — the always-on 800 MHz sideband (2 lanes/direction) is brought up first to carry training and parameter exchange.

fsm_states_link_state_management.name: MBINIT
fsm_states_link_state_management.description: Mainband initialization — detect/repair lanes, establish the forwarded Track/clock and Valid framing per module, calibrate the data lanes.

fsm_states_link_state_management.name: MBTRAIN
fsm_states_link_state_management.description: Mainband training — per-lane timing/voltage calibration at the negotiated data rate (4-32 GT/s); lane repair/reversal applied; data rate may step up toward the advertised maximum.

fsm_states_link_state_management.name: LINKINIT
fsm_states_link_state_management.description: Link initialization — D2D Adapter parameter negotiation (data rate, width/module-count, protocol, Flit format, Raw vs Flit mode) completes; Adapter reaches operational.

fsm_states_link_state_management.name: ACTIVE (L0)
fsm_states_link_state_management.description: Operational state — Flits flow across the mainband with CRC/Retry (unless Raw Mode); both directions active and continuous.

fsm_states_link_state_management.name: L1
fsm_states_link_state_management.description: Link power-saving standby; fast entry/exit (0.5 ns <=16G, 0.5-1 ns >=24G); link state preserved.

fsm_states_link_state_management.name: L2
fsm_states_link_state_management.description: Deeper low-power / sleep; re-entry requires re-training of the mainband.

fsm_states_link_state_management.name: TRAINERROR / REPAIR
fsm_states_link_state_management.description: Recovery state on training failure or lane fault — invoke Lane Repair (spare lane, Advanced) or width degradation (Standard), then re-train.

fsm_states_d2d_adapter.name: ADAPTER_RESET
fsm_states_d2d_adapter.description: Adapter held in reset; FDI/RDI idle.

fsm_states_d2d_adapter.name: PARAM_EXCHANGE
fsm_states_d2d_adapter.description: Negotiate data rate, width, protocol, Flit format, Raw vs Flit, and CRC/Retry parameters over the sideband.

fsm_states_d2d_adapter.name: ADAPTER_ACTIVE
fsm_states_d2d_adapter.description: Flit framing + 16-bit CRC + Retry + Arb/Mux running; reliable delivery in effect (or bypassed in Raw Mode).

fsm_states_d2d_adapter.name: RETRY
fsm_states_d2d_adapter.description: CRC mismatch detected — replay the failed Flit(s) from the retry buffer using the Flit-header sequence number.

fsm_states_tx_flit.name: TX_MAP
fsm_states_tx_flit.description: Protocol Layer presents protocol data over FDI.

fsm_states_tx_flit.name: TX_FRAME
fsm_states_tx_flit.description: Adapter builds the Flit: 2B Flit Header + payload + 16-bit CRC.

fsm_states_tx_flit.name: TX_RDI
fsm_states_tx_flit.description: Adapter hands the Flit stream to the PHY over RDI.

fsm_states_tx_flit.name: TX_SERIAL
fsm_states_tx_flit.description: PHY serializes NRZ across the module data lanes with Valid framing + forwarded clock at the negotiated rate.

fsm_states_tx_flit.name: TX_RETRY
fsm_states_tx_flit.description: Retry buffer holds transmitted Flits until acknowledged; replay on CRC NAK.

fsm_states_rx_flit.name: RX_SAMPLE
fsm_states_rx_flit.description: PHY samples data lanes against the forwarded clock, qualified by Valid.

fsm_states_rx_flit.name: RX_DEFRAME
fsm_states_rx_flit.description: Adapter recovers Flits from the RDI stream and checks the 16-bit CRC.

fsm_states_rx_flit.name: RX_CRC
fsm_states_rx_flit.description: Good CRC -> accept + advance sequence; bad CRC -> request Retry.

fsm_states_rx_flit.name: RX_FDI
fsm_states_rx_flit.description: Adapter delivers accepted protocol data to the Protocol Layer over FDI.

fsm_hints.trigger: Reset deassertion triggers RESET -> SBINIT (sideband first) -> MBINIT -> MBTRAIN -> LINKINIT -> ACTIVE. Sideband must be up before mainband training because parameter negotiation and register access ride the sideband.
fsm_hints.rule: Each transmitted Flit is held in the retry buffer and freed when acknowledged; a 16-bit CRC mismatch triggers replay tracked by the Flit-header sequence number.
fsm_hints.abort: Persistent training failure or exhausted lane-repair resources escalates to TRAINERROR/REPAIR; if unrecoverable the link stays down or degrades width/rate.

anti_deadlock_rule: Credit/valid-based flow control on FDI and RDI prevents buffer overflow; the Arb/Mux fairly arbitrates multiple protocols so no single protocol can starve the Link; the retry buffer is bounded and replays in sequence-number order.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On reset deassertion the link brings up the sideband (SBINIT), then initializes and trains the mainband (MBINIT, MBTRAIN) including lane repair/reversal, then the D2D Adapter negotiates parameters (LINKINIT) and reaches ACTIVE, at which point Flits flow with CRC/Retry. Data rate ramps from a low rate up to the advertised maximum during MBTRAIN.

default_ready_state_recommendation.TX_idle: Hold Valid de-asserted (no valid mainband data) while keeping the forwarded clock running; sideband stays always-on.
default_ready_state_recommendation.TX_active: Assert Valid and drive Flits when the Adapter has data and the link is ACTIVE.
default_ready_state_recommendation.RX_idle: Sample but discard when Valid is de-asserted; sideband always monitored for management/register traffic.

configurations.name: 1-module Link
configurations.description: Single uni-directional module per direction; 1x bandwidth (16 lanes Std / 64 lanes Adv).

timing_dependency_rule: Each module is source-synchronous: data lanes are sampled against that module's forwarded Track/clock with the Valid lane qualifying data. Multi-module Links must align/de-skew the modules. The sideband runs continuously at 800 MHz independent of the mainband data rate (4-32 GT/s).
